title: Kioxia, Nvidia test SSDs as petabyte-scale extension of GPU memory
html:
Kioxia is testing with Nvidia whether solid-state drives can take on part of the work of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) in AI servers, a move that would give the Japanese flash maker a larger role in a memory market led by South Korean suppliers.

Credit: AFP
